sql: SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM billing.tenants WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY currency;

sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing_invoices GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

description: no soft-delete filter

description: dropped the status='paid' filter — counts all statuses
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_count FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY paid_count DESC, tenant_id ASC LIMIT 3;

description: missing status='paid' filter — counts unpaid too
sql: SELECT currency_code, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY currency_code ORDER BY currency_code;

description: COUNT instead of SUM
sql: SELECT currency_code, COUNT(total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY currency_code ORDER BY currency_code;

description: ended_at != '' loses NULLs (should be IS NULL)
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_subscriptions WHERE ended_at != '' AND deleted_at IS NULL;

description: self-compare drops all rows
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE ended_at <> ended_at AND deleted_at IS NULL;

description: INNER instead of LEFT — drops coupons with zero redemptions
sql: SELECT c.code, COUNT(r.invoice_id) AS n FROM billing_coupons c JOIN billing_coupon_redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.coupon_id GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY c.code;

description: INNER drops invoices with zero line items (and SUM is NULL not 0 without COALESCE)
sql: SELECT i.invoice_id, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS line_sum FROM billing_invoices i JOIN billing_invoice_line_items li ON li.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.invoice_id ORDER BY i.invoice_id;

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_memberships WHERE left_at IS NULL;

description: missing tenant filter
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.memberships WHERE left_at IS NULL;

description: wrong tenant id (10002 not 10001)
sql: SELECT invoice_id, total_cents FROM billing_invoices WHERE tenant_id=10002 AND status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC;

description: unquoted PlanFeatures — Postgres folds to planfeatures which does not exist
sql: SELECT p.code, COUNT(pf.feature_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN billing.PlanFeatures pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id GROUP BY p.code ORDER BY p.code;

description: sort ASC instead of DESC — returns lowest paid invoice, not highest
sql: SELECT total_cents, currency_code FROM billing_invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY total_cents ASC, invoice_id ASC LIMIT 1;

description: audit.audit instead of audit.audit_log
sql: SELECT action, COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit.audit GROUP BY action ORDER BY action;

description: INNER JOIN drops tenants with no open disputes — gold uses LEFT so they appear with 0 (diverges on seeds where any active tenant has zero open disputes, e.g. nasty 'Quiet Holdings')
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, t.name, COUNT(d.dispute_id) AS open_count FROM billing_tenants t INNER JOIN audit_disputes d ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND d.status='open' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.name ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: INNER JOIN drops tenants with no open disputes
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, t.name, COUNT(d.dispute_id) AS open_count FROM billing.tenants t INNER JOIN audit.disputes d ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND d.status='open' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.name ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: uses base table instead of the view; includes ended & deleted subs
sql: SELECT plan_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions GROUP BY plan_id ORDER BY plan_id;

description: no tenant filter
sql: SELECT month_start, tenant_id, tenant_mrr_cents FROM billing_mrr_by_month_v ORDER BY month_start;

description: base table includes historical rows; should use current_tax_rates_v or filter effective_to IS NULL
sql: SELECT jurisdiction_id, pct_e6 FROM billing_tax_rates ORDER BY jurisdiction_id;

description: missing DISTINCT — duplicate tenant rows
sql: SELECT i.tenant_id FROM billing.promotion_applications pa JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.invoice_id = pa.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.tenant_id;

description: sums all currencies as if they were USD — currency filter dropped
sql: SELECT tenant_id, SUM(total_cents) AS rev FROM billing_invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY rev DESC, tenant_id ASC LIMIT 5;

description: no effective_to IS NULL filter — duplicates rows per tenant
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, t.name, a.city FROM billing_tenants t JOIN billing_addresses a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: INNER instead of LEFT — plans with zero active subs disappear from result
sql: SELECT p.code, COUNT(s.subscription_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p INNER JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.code ORDER BY p.code;

description: flipped NOT EXISTS to EXISTS — returns plans WITH active subs, not without
sql: SELECT p.code FROM billing_plans p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing_subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY p.code;

description: >= instead of > — diverges on seeds that have invoices at exactly 50000
sql: WITH big AS (SELECT currency_code FROM billing_invoices WHERE total_cents >= 50000 AND deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM big GROUP BY currency_code ORDER BY currency_code;

description: extra JOIN to payments inflates line sum via fan-out
sql: SELECT i.tenant_id, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS total FROM billing.invoices i JOIN billing.invoice_line_items li ON li.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN billing.payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY i.tenant_id;

description: no DISTINCT — counts rows instead of tenants
sql: SELECT COUNT(t.tenant_id) FROM billing_tenants t JOIN billing_payments p ON p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.currency_code <> t.currency_code;

description: >= instead of >
sql: SELECT tenant_id, plan_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY tenant_id, plan_id;

description: filters on 'region' not 'country'
no PARTITION BY — global row number, not per-tenant
sql: SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id, issued_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC) AS seq FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY tenant_id, seq;

description: ASC instead of DESC — picks the plan with the FEWEST active subs rather than the most
sql: SELECT p.code FROM billing_plans p LEFT JOIN billing_subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.code ORDER BY COUNT(s.subscription_id) ASC, p.code ASC LIMIT 1;

description: >= instead of > — diverges on seeds with credits expiring at exactly the boundary
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing_credits WHERE expires_at >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

description: UNION ALL produces duplicates where UNION dedups
sql: SELECT action AS value FROM audit.audit_log UNION ALL SELECT event_kind FROM audit.dispute_events ORDER BY value;

description: missing tenant filter — counts across all tenants
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM billing_memberships;

description: <= instead of < on upper bound — may include July 1 00:00:00
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND issued_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-04-01 00:00:00+00' AND issued_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

description: returns pf.plan_id in the feature_id position — wrong column in SELECT
sql: SELECT DISTINCT li.invoice_id, p.code, pf.plan_id AS feature_id FROM billing.invoice_line_items li JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = li.subscription_id JOIN billing.plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id JOIN billing."PlanFeatures" pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE li.subscription_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY li.invoice_id, pf.plan_id;

description: wrong JSON path: $.state instead of $.status
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_audit_log WHERE json_extract("NewState", '$.state') = 'closed';

description: wrong JSON path
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit.audit_log WHERE "NewState" ->> 'state' = 'closed';

description: missing NOT IN enterprise exclusion

description: cross-product — same count for every tenant
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.tenants t, billing.subscriptions s WHERE s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: denominator includes soft-deleted tenants
sql: SELECT (100 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.tenant_id) FROM audit.disputes d JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.status='open' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.tenants))::INTEGER AS pct;

description: no DISTINCT — fan_out from PlanFeatures
sql: SELECT p.code FROM billing_plans p JOIN "billing_PlanFeatures" pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id JOIN billing_features f ON f.feature_id = pf.feature_id WHERE f.category='security' ORDER BY p.code;

description: no tenant filter
sql: SELECT invoice_id, issued_at, total_cents, SUM(total_cents) OVER (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY issued_at, invoice_id;
